description: The drxinfra.ru checklist for upgrading Directum RX with a way back: 44 items in 7 phases, from two weeks before the window through the rehearsal on a test contour, the rollback plan, the window itself, checks before users come back and the first day. Optionally marks done items and returns a link that opens the same marks on drxinfra.ru/upgrade-checklist.html, where they can be printed or saved.

done.description: Numbers of the items already done (1-44)

from_version.description: Current RX version, for the link (up to 40 characters)

to_version.description: Target RX version, for the link (up to 40 characters)

window.description: Planned window, for the link, e.g. 15.12 22:00-06:00 (up to 40 characters)

name: upgrade_checklist
title: Directum RX upgrade checklist
